subject: 明代北方府城：佛寺殿堂（原创扩展）；具体构件断代（待考）。
prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Produce one photorealistic ancient Chinese map-building cutout in true transparent RGBA. Image1 is exact mandatory ground geometry; image2 is architecture/material/style reference only. Render the geometry from IMAGE1 exactly, do not rotate, reshape or deepen it. The front two outer ground edges MUST rise/run 1/2, absolute slope 0.500, parallel paving seams on same axes. Orthographic dimetric 2:1, yaw45, vertical edges stay vertical. The geometry template is just the support; render natural stone paving and architecture, remove drawn outlines. Fully opaque fine-grained gray masonry and clay tile texture matching image2; upper-left daylight, extremely short lower-right contact shadow. Full structure and support uncropped. No people, animals, labels, letters, watermarks, scenery or border. Horizontal1536x1024. Add ONE Ming northern Buddhist temple hall from image2: dark gray hip-gable XIESHAN tiled roof, restrained red-brown timber columns and fine lattice doors, low gray stone platform; no enclosure. Ground platform exactly14x11m from guide: left(90,559),front(846,937),right(1440,640),back(684,262); long front edge756 pixels run378 rise, side594 run297 rise. The side is eleven-fourteenths of facade length, so hall is DEEP. Preserve image1 corners precisely; hall sits inside with roof top near y70. Entrance steps must be RECESSED INTO platform and never project past outer ground edges. Front face and side have identical±0.5 ground slopes. Same realistic tile and timber density as image2.
